recipes.title: Creamy Tomato Pasta Bake
recipes.instructions:
Preheat the oven to 375°F (190°C). Cook pasta according to the package instructions until al dente. Drain and set aside.
In a large skillet, sauté the red onion and onion over medium heat until softened. Add the grape tomatoes and cook for an additional 3 minutes.
In a large mixing bowl, combine cooked pasta, tomato mixture, milk, egg, and butter. Mix well to combine.
Transfer the pasta mixture to a baking dish and bake in the preheated oven for 20 minutes or until golden brown on top.

recipes.title: Spaghetti Aglio e Olio with Tomato and Grape Tomatoes
recipes.instructions:
Bring a large pot of salted water to a boil and cook the spaghetti according to package instructions until al dente.
While the spaghetti is cooking, heat olive oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat. Add sliced red onion and cook for about 3 minutes or until translucent.
Add garlic to the skillet (use one of the egg pieces minced) and cook for another minute, stirring constantly to prevent burning.
Add chopped tomatoes and grape tomato. Stir in cooked spaghetti from pot. Simmer sauce together for a few minutes until the flavors are combined.

recipes.title: Cheesy Garlic Bread Pasta Bake
recipes.instructions:
Preheat the oven to 375°F (190°C). Slice the bread into 1-inch thick slices.
Cook the pasta according to package instructions until al dente. Drain and set aside.
In a large skillet, sauté the red onion and garlic in a little bit of oil until softened.
In a separate saucepan, mix together milk, eggs, and tomatoes. Simmer for 5-7 minutes until slightly thickened. Combine cooked pasta and tomato mixture in a baking dish. Top with bread slices and grated cheese (optional) and bake for 15-20 minutes until golden brown.

suggestions.name: olive oil
suggestions.reason: Use about three quarters as much; best in savoury cooking.

messages.text: How do I know the pasta is al dente?
Taste a piece a minute before the packet time. It should be tender with a slight bite in the centre.
